name: Cubes-TS-TW

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows both the tilted cubes and a broad lilac ripple across the grid.

tagline: Squares tip into small cubes as the pointer crosses the grid.
summary: An eight-by-eight field of dashed purple squares sits flat until cells near the pointer rotate into 3D cubes; a click sends rings of pale lilac across the faces.
appearance: A square grid of small dark cells with thin purple dashed borders, evenly spaced on black. Cells under the pointer lift into cube shapes with lit faces, and a click turns whole rings of cells pale lilac.
behaviour: Cells within a short radius of the pointer tilt on two axes, the nearest most, and ease back when it leaves. Left alone, a virtual pointer wanders the grid; a click washes expanding rings of colour outward.
search_phrases: grid of squares that tip into cubes
pointer tilt on a square grid
animated grid for a hero background
wave of light across a grid
use_when: A tech product wants a decorative interactive backdrop that rewards hovering and clicking.
avoid_when: The dense dashed grid and constant motion can overwhelm copy laid over it, and the ripple is mouse-led.
customise: Grid density, tilt angle and radius, gap, face and border colour, shadow, auto animation, and ripple colour and speed are props. There is no content to pass in.
weight_why: Sixty-four cubes with six faces each, all retweened every frame while auto-animating.

a11y.note: Decorative only; the pointer and click effects have no keyboard route and the auto animation ignores reduced-motion settings.

issues: The dashed purple borders are low contrast against the near-black faces.
Auto mode and the pointer fight over the same cells, so the motion occasionally jumps.
polish_why: Crisp isometric tilts and a satisfying ripple; the dense grid and faint dashes cost clarity.
